subtitle: A closer look at my background, how I work, and the results I deliver.
paragraphs: Cloud Security and IAM Engineer with 4+ years of experience in enterprise security delivery, identity and access management, and cloud infrastructure automation. At Accenture I automated access provisioning and identity governance with Entra ID and PowerShell, and implemented RBAC/ABAC and SSO across cloud environments.

Today I work at an MSP, automating endpoint security and operations work across SentinelOne, Sophos, Huntress and NinjaOne. I hold an MS in Computer Science from NJIT with a focus on cloud security, cryptography and AI. I am open to relocating anywhere in the US.
